answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27572 Country: India Title: I'm working as Engineer. I get my salary in cheques only. So I must compulsorily have savings account. The bank will earn me an interest at the rate of 3.5% compounded half yearly. Whether this earnings is haram? If yes, what is solution for me? Please guide me... Question: Assalamu alaikum. I'm working as Engineer. I get my salary in cheques only. So I must compulsorily have savings account. The bank will earn me an interest at the rate of 3.5% compounded half yearly. Whether this earnings is haram? If yes, what is solution for me? Please guide me... Answer ID: 27572 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1692/1219/L=1431) The 3.5% extra amount that the bank gives is interest. It is not lawful to use it for oneself. This amount should be given in charity to the poor and needy ones without the intention of reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
